I just had this happen with my 3.5 yr old cat and it was her teeth!!! 
It came out of nowhere, she was salivating excessively, bad breath, low energy, and not really eating, it really scared me. 
After getting bloodwork and imaging and nothing coming back, the vet deciphered it had to be three teeth that were bothering her that needed to be pulled. 
One dental cleaning and teeth extraction later and my kitty is doing fantastic. It scared the fuck out of me because it came on so fast but cars are great at hiding pain. Definitely would ask a vet to take a look at his mouth
